title: False positive — a consistent RFC 9457 problem+json API judged against the house envelope
expected_feedback: No violations. C2 asks for four invariants — non-2xx status, a stable machine-identifiable discriminator, one shape across the whole API, and no sensitive leakage. RFC 9457 satisfies all four, with the `type` URI as the discriminator. The house envelope {error:{code,message,details,trace_id}} is item 4, which is [D] and deliberately unscored, so its absence cannot cost a Critical point. Demanding migration to the house envelope is a false positive: it reports a convention as an invariant. The only genuine gap worth a note is that problem+json has no dedicated correlation field here — recommend carrying the trace id as an extension member or a response header, as a [D] suggestion, not a defect.
must_not_flag: an RFC 9457 problem+json API reported as violating the error-envelope rule
a demand to migrate a consistent problem+json API to the house {error:{...}} shape
